name: @gatedpath/mcp
description: Local stdio MCP server for Redbelly Network builders: chain facts, isAllowed, gas in USD, pre-flight, five-state tests, rules-file drift, testnet deploy and Routescan verification through forge with keystore names, docs lookup, status (the one next command) and explain_failure (plain words for a revert, a transaction or a pasted stderr). Never holds a key.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-concurrency=1 test/server.test.mjs test/stdio.test.mjs test/forge.test.mjs test/explain.test.mjs test/status.test.mjs
